column2: DL timing drift is defined as the variation rate of the downlink delay in ppm due to the service link Doppler over the UE Rx-Tx time difference measurement period.For frequency range 1, the reference point for the DL timing drift measurement shall be the Rx antenna connector of the UE. For frequency range 2, the reference point for the DL timing drift measurement shall be the Rx antenna of the UE.
